title: 第5章 火速集 合第6章 大小姐的杀气
content_zh:
第5章 火速集合
新手村小树林是整个新手村最大的练级地图，这里栖息着从5级到10级的各种怪物，也是最受玩家欢迎的练级地图，刘烨对这里相当熟悉，很快便找到了这里。
和自己记忆中一样，新手村小树林还是那样的混乱，随处可见各个等级的玩家，《封神》刚刚开服，整个联邦数十亿玩家聚集在一万个新手村，但是玩家比怪物多的情况依然存在！
不少玩家因为一只森林野狗大打出手，有钱有势的玩家拼着联邦币在游戏里拉帮结派，在练级区横冲直撞，他们往往会包围一片练级区贡自己练级。
刘烨一路走来，不少玩家看到他都会露出敌意，不过刘烨不在乎这些，因为他来这里并不是为了抢怪！
“哥可是要去杀BOSS的人，没见识的麻瓜们！”刘烨鄙夷的轻笑一声，朝着小树林深处走去。
四周的玩家越来越少，再往前便是8级怪物黑熊的聚集地，自己的任务目标就在这片树林的另一边，也就是10级怪物的聚集地。
“老大，那小子的装备看上去不错！”两名7级的玩家正在辛苦的屠杀着黑熊，看到刘烨身上精致的装备，目光立刻亮了起来。
“小子，说你呢！站住！”其中一名叫做圣火的骑士玩家上前拦住刘烨的去路。
刘烨眉头一皱，诧异的看着挡在自己身前的两人，为首的法师玩家长得白白净净，角色名竟然是等级榜第三的见钱眼开，心中不免有些好奇，“两位找我有什么事吗？”
见钱眼开仔细打量刘烨一番，满脸高傲的说道：“我看你这一身装备不错，开个价吧！”
“哦？原来你是要卖我的装备啊？好说好说！”刘烨玩味一笑，说道。
“算你识趣，我们老大最不缺的就是钱！”骑士玩家圣火明显跟自己一样，扮演着跟班角色，阴阳怪气的说道。
另一边的见钱眼开轻笑不语，眼前这个小子还算识趣！
刘烨心中冷笑一声，平静的扫视两人，道：“我身上一共有四件紫装，每件一百万金币，不贵吧？”
“什么？！”
见钱眼开两人的脸色瞬间难看下来，一件紫装一百万金币，相当于一百万联邦币，“小子，你这是在找死！”
“是吗？我怎么没有发现？”刘烨玩味的笑道。
“不识趣的家伙，得罪本少爷的下场可是很凄惨的！”见钱眼开冷笑一声，朝着一旁的圣火说道：“圣火，挂掉这小子，把他身上的装备全都爆出来，然后送回零级！”
“好嘞！”骑士玩家圣火收到命令，立刻挥动手中的精铁重剑，向刘烨砍过去，与此同时，见钱眼开已经退到了圣火身后，飞快射出一颗火球。

刘烨冷笑一声，脚踩精致皮靴，一个华丽的弧形走位避开重剑和火球术的攻击，新技能怒斩催动，手中的鬼王剑霎那间化作一片赤红，直指法师见钱眼开！
“－107”
恐怖的伤害数字从见钱眼开头顶升起，法师职业本就体弱，现阶段的法师更是这样，刘烨的一道怒斩直接将他打成残血。
见钱眼开大惊失色，急忙和跟班二号拉开距离，喝下血瓶，口中大喊大叫：“圣火，要你干什么？！老子都快挂了！”
那边的圣火脸色一变，急忙转身，又是一道重击向跟班二号砸过来，可惜骑士的攻速只有两星，而刘烨身为隐藏职业九转剑仙，拥有着四星攻速，抬手挥出一道重击，将圣火的攻击抵消。
“你们这样的麻瓜，人数没上两位数也敢来挑战哥的威严！”
玩味的扫视圣火一眼，操纵跟班二号左右晃动前进，花哨的蛇形走位让圣火眼花缭乱，而此时，跟班二号已经快速的来到见钱眼开面前。
见钱眼开脸色惨白，知道自己遇到了游戏高手，猛地一咬牙，射出一颗火球术！
只见那火球快要击中跟班二号的时候，刘烨忽然间向左边跨出一步，刚好躲开了火球术的攻击，同时掀起一道重击砸过去，正中见钱眼开脑门，在封神的PK设定中，击中头部要害是有攻击加成的。
砰——“－112”
本就已经残血的见钱眼开直接躺倒，爆出一件装备，不过刘烨没有着急去捡，而是迅速转身，向圣火杀过去。
一番战斗之下，圣火早已经明白自己的处境，只是看到自己老板挂掉，心中很是痛苦，怒吼一声，朝跟班二号冲过去，“我跟你拼了！”
“有用吗？”
刘烨玩味一笑，脚步灵活多变，每次都可以轻松的躲开圣火的攻击，绕到圣火背后，重击落下——“－103”
圣火的生命直接下降了五分之一，骑士的体质成长和自己一样是三星，不过骑士一般都会选择体质加点，因此圣火的生命值大概在520左右。
不过这样的生命值在现阶段的刘烨眼中实在不算什么，两道重击加一道怒斩，其中出了一次暴击，刚好将圣火撂倒在地！
翠绿的树林里躺着两个尸体，许久之后才不甘心的化作白光回城，同时，等级榜上排名第三的见钱眼开直接掉落榜单，在世界频道引起了不小的轰动。
刘烨可没心情在意这些，美滋滋的将两人爆出来的装备捡起来，圣火掉出一件蓝色胸甲，见钱眼开则是一条紫色的项链：
【狼皮上衣】（蓝色装备）
等级：7

耐久度：98/98
基础属性：物理防御+12
附加属性：体质+1
【微光项链】（紫色装备）
等级：5
耐久度：105/105
基础属性：物理防御+9、魔法值+25
附加属性：耐力+2
两件不错的装备，项链自己还没有，刚好填补空白，胸甲正好将自己身上1级的粗制皮甲替换下来，直接扔在了地上，这种低级货色，丢在地上都没人要的。
自己刚好要去杀BOSS，没想到半路有人送装备，得意的笑了笑，飞快的
ID：跟班二号
职业：九转剑仙
等级：7
声望：37
称号：无
生命值：460
魔法值：335
物理攻击：95－103
魔法攻击：32
物防：46

魔防：17
美滋滋的关闭个人属性栏，正准备向大黑熊的所在地开进，这个时候却收到一条好友申请：“叮！”——
系统提示：玩家蝶恋花（智士－7级）申请添加好友，验证消息为：二号，是大姐大我！是否接受？
看到这条好友邀请，刘烨嘴角不自觉的**起来，无奈的点击添加，很快便收到了恶霸二小姐的好友消息，“二号，火速集合！小树林（4590，12598）！”
面对恶霸二小姐，刘烨当然不会忘记拍拍马屁，轻笑着回复道：“哇，二小姐的名字好有诗意！不知道叫小的有什么事吗？”
“哎呀，别拍马屁了！有人找场子，再不来你大姐大我就要挂掉了！”
刘烨一愣，急忙回复道：“小姐放心，马上就到！”
关闭对话框，刘烨脸色有些怪异，自己这个二小姐还真不省心，这才开始多久？这么快就惹了麻烦？！
不过话又说回来了，自己现在身为人家的法定卖身跟班，有义务保护二小姐的安危，服从二小姐的命令，要是二小姐在游戏里受到欺负，责任肯定会算在自己头上。
想到大小姐叶雨轩眼中浓重的杀气，刘烨不由一阵哆嗦，撒开腿朝着指定坐标杀过去，“我的二小姐啊！你可千万要坚持住，你死了我在叶家怎么混？”
怀着满腔热血，刘烨暂时放弃了击杀大黑熊任务，风风火火的朝着事发地点跑过去！
好在自己也在小树林，事发地点并不远，三分钟后，刘烨迅速的赶到了。
只见那边两个娇小的丫头片子激烈的战斗着，其中叫做蝶恋花的智士玩家正是自己的大姐大叶雨蝶，而她的对手则是一个同样嚣张的小萝莉法师，ID叫做魔法小猫！
两人一边厮杀一边相互咒骂，看上去一个比一个嚣张，刘烨越看越傻眼，很明显，恶霸二小姐遇到对手了。
“咦，二小姐玩的不错嘛！果然是有其母必有其女……那个小萝莉法师也不错，很有前途！”见状的刘烨停下脚步，悠闲的观赏起来。
“二号，快点过来帮我，我要挂了这个臭丫头！”二小姐看到刘烨，惊喜的喊道。
“哦！”刘烨一愣，才想到自己是来帮忙的，急忙朝着两位小恶霸冲过去。
二小姐这边，一双小手灵活的挥动短剑，在空中划出一道淡紫色的幽光，可爱的俏脸上写满得意之色，“臭丫头，我的肉盾来了，受死吧！”
魔法小猫娇小的身影轻轻律动，躲开了二小姐的攻击，骄横的说道：“哼，狗屁肉盾，来一个我杀一个！”
“切，只要挂了你，本小姐就是这里的老大！”二小姐嚣张的指着对方，再次厮杀过去。

刘烨刚好在这个时候冲上来，听到两个丫头片子的对话，差点吐血，什么肉盾？什么狗屁肉盾？哥可是明星级玩家，史上最强跟班、最强肉盾，还来一个杀一个？这只小猫太嚣张了！
说时迟那时快，跟班二号一个熟练的菱形回旋走位，踏过一条折线，精准的落在魔法小猫身后，一道重击狠狠的砸在她的小屁屁上，砰——“－108”
“让你看看什么才是高手！”刘烨愤恨的说道。
受到攻击的小猫MM大惊失色，急忙向一旁躲开，将一颗火球术射在刘烨的脸上！
系统提示：受到玩家（魔法小猫）攻击，失去115点生命值。
“咦，这丫头的技术跟谁学的？这个背击火球玩的不错嘛！”刘烨一愣，诧异的看向这位小萝莉法师，没想到一个小丫头竟然玩起了背击火球，这要是说出来，得让多少人汗颜？
“二号，做的不错！”二小姐看到魔法小猫被刘烨打成残血，惊喜的赞赏一句，兴奋的朝着魔法小猫杀过去，“臭丫头，你完了！”
魔法小猫小脸惨白，眼看着二小姐杀过来，忍不住瞪了刘烨一眼，如果不是这个讨厌的家伙出现，自己怎么可能输给这个嚣张的丫头？
就在这个时候，一道优雅唯美的身影冲了过来，一颗精准的火球术抵消蝶恋花的攻击，并将其逼退。
魔法小猫大喜，看到身后赶过来的一群家族玩家，惊喜的叫道：“姐姐，你们可终于来了，猫猫差点被这臭丫头杀死！”
“猫猫乖，姐姐给你处理！”气质高贵的女法师宠溺的安慰道。
话说这边的二小姐在看到对方的阵容以后，没有丝毫的惊慌，而是临危不惧的站在刘烨身后，说道：“二号，臭丫头的救兵来了，你帮我掩护，我要跑路了！”
刘烨愕然，对二小姐相当无语，好在对方只有五个人，对自己威胁的并不大，只是那名气质高贵的女法师引起了他的注意。
当他看到女法师绝美的容貌和她头顶的ID之后，忍不住心中一颤，“九玄月？总算遇到熟人了！”
眼前这位美眉就是自己前世“为数不多”的女性好友之一，同样的高贵相貌，同样的ID名字，只是玄月MM什么时候多出一个如此嚣张的妹妹？

content_en:
Chapter 5 Quick gathering
The Novice Village Grove is the largest leveling map in the entire Novice Village. It is home to various monsters from level 5 to level 10. It is also the most popular leveling map among players. Liu Ye was quite familiar with this place and found it quickly.
Just like in my memory, the grove in the novice village is still chaotic. Players of all levels can be seen everywhere. "Feng Shen" has just launched its server. Billions of players in the entire federation have gathered in 10,000 novice villages. However, there are still more players than monsters!
Many players got into fights because of a wild dog in the forest. Rich and powerful players used federal coins to form gangs in the game and ran rampant in the leveling area. They often surrounded a leveling area to help themselves level up.
Along Liu Ye's journey, many players showed hostility when they saw him, but Liu Ye didn't care about this because he didn't come here to grab monsters!
"Brother, you are going to kill the BOSS, you ignorant Muggles!" Liu Ye chuckled contemptuously and walked towards the depths of the grove.
There are fewer and fewer players around. Further ahead is the gathering place of level 8 monster black bears. My mission target is on the other side of this forest, which is the gathering place of level 10 monsters.
"Boss, that guy's equipment looks good!" Two level 7 players were hard at work slaughtering black bears. When they saw the exquisite equipment on Liu Ye's body, their eyes immediately lit up.
"Boy, it's you! Stop!" One of the knight players named Holy Fire stepped forward to block Liu Ye's way.
Liu Ye frowned and looked at the two people standing in front of him in surprise. The leading mage player was fair and fair, and his character name was actually the third-ranked player named Qian Qiankai. He couldn't help but feel curious, "What do you two want from me?"
Seeing Qian opened his eyes and looked at Liu Ye carefully, he said with a proud face: "I think your equipment is good, please give me a price!"
"Oh? So you want to sell my equipment? It's easy to talk!" Liu Ye said with a playful smile.
"You know what's interesting, the most important thing our boss needs is money!" The knight player Sheng Huo obviously played the role of a follower like himself, and said in a strange tone.
The man on the other side smiled softly when he saw the money. The boy in front of him was quite sensible!
Liu Ye sneered in his heart, glanced at the two of them calmly, and said, "I have a total of four purple outfits, each worth one million gold coins. Isn't that expensive?"
"What?!"
Seeing the money, the two people's expressions suddenly turned ugly. A purple outfit costs one million gold coins, which is equivalent to one million federal coins. "Boy, you are looking for death!"
"Really? Why didn't I notice it?" Liu Ye smiled playfully.
"The consequences for those ignorant guys who offend this young master will be very miserable!" Seeing the money, he sneered and said to the Holy Fire on the side: "Holy Fire, kill this kid, explode all the equipment on him, and send him back to level zero!"
"Okay!" After receiving the order, the knight player Shenghuo immediately waved the fine iron heavy sword in his hand and slashed at Liu Ye. At the same time, seeing Qian Yankai retreating behind Shenghuo, he quickly shot a fireball.
Liu Ye sneered, stepped on exquisite leather boots, and moved in a gorgeous arc to avoid the attacks of the heavy sword and fireball. He activated his new skill Furious Slash, and the Ghost King Sword in his hand instantly turned into a red color, pointing straight at the mage and his eyes widened when he saw the money!
"-107"
Terrifying damage figures rose from the top of his head. The mage profession was already weak, and the current mage was even more so. Liu Ye's furious slash directly knocked him to the lowest level of health.
Seeing Qian's eyes widened in shock, he hurriedly distanced himself from Follower No. 2, drank the blood bottle, and shouted: "Holy Fire, what do I want from you?! I'm almost dead!"
The face of the holy fire over there changed, and he turned around hurriedly, and hit the follower No. 2 with another heavy blow. Unfortunately, the knight's attack speed was only two stars, and Liu Ye, as a hidden professional nine-turn swordsman, had a four-star attack speed.He swung a heavy blow with his hand, neutralizing the attack of the holy fire.
"Muggles like you dare to challenge my majesty even if your number is less than double digits!"
He glanced at the Holy Fire playfully, and controlled Follower No. 2 to swing forward from side to side. His fancy snake-like movements dazzled the Holy Fire. At this time, Follower No. 2 had already quickly arrived in front of Qian Qiankai.
Seeing Qian's eyes open and his face pale, he knew that he had met a master of the game. He gritted his teeth suddenly and shot a fireball!
When the fireball was about to hit Follower No. 2, Liu Ye suddenly took a step to the left, just in time to avoid the attack of the fireball. At the same time, he launched a heavy blow and hit him in the forehead. In the PK setting of Fengshen, hitting the vital part of the head has an attack bonus.
Bang——“-112”
Seeing Qian's eyes open, Liu Ye, who was already already on low health, immediately lay down, and a piece of equipment exploded. However, Liu Ye did not rush to pick it up, but quickly turned around and charged towards the Holy Fire.
After a battle, Shenghuo already understood his situation, but when he saw his boss died, he felt very painful. He roared and rushed towards Follower No. 2, "I'll fight you!"
"Is it useful?"
Liu Ye smiled playfully, his steps were flexible and he could easily dodge the attacks of the Holy Fire every time, go around behind the Holy Fire, and land a heavy blow - "-103"
The Holy Fire's health dropped by one-fifth. The knight's physical growth was the same as his own at three stars, but the knight usually chose to add points to his physical constitution, so the Holy Fire's health was about 520.
However, this kind of health is nothing in the eyes of Liu Ye at this stage. Two heavy blows and a furious slash, one of which was a critical hit, just knocked the Holy Fire to the ground!
Two corpses were lying in the green woods. After a long time, they turned into white light and returned to the city unwillingly. At the same time, the third-ranked corpse fell off the list immediately, causing quite a sensation on the World Channel.
Liu Ye was not in the mood to care about this. He happily picked up the equipment that the two people had exploded. The Holy Fire dropped a blue breastplate, and when he saw the money, a purple necklace appeared:
[Wolf Skin Top] (Blue Equipment)
Level: 7
Durability: 98/98
Basic attributes: Physical defense +12
Additional attribute: Physical fitness +1
[Glimmer Necklace] (Purple Equipment)
Level: 5
Durability: 105/105
Basic attributes: physical defense +9, magic value +25
Additional attributes: Stamina +2
Two good pieces of equipment. The necklace I didn't have yet, just filled the gap. The breastplate just replaced the level 1 rough leather armor on my body, and threw it directly on the ground. No one would want such low-level goods on the ground.
I was just about to kill the BOSS, but I didn't expect someone to send me equipment halfway. I smiled proudly and quickly
ID: Follower No. 2
Occupation: Nine-turn Sword Immortal
Level: 7
Reputation: 37
Title: None
HP: 460
Magic value: 335
Physical attack: 95-103
Magic Attack: 32
Physical defense: 46
Magic Defense: 17
I happily closed my personal attribute bar and was about to drive towards the location of the big black bear, when I received a friend request: "Ding!"——
System prompts: The player Die Lianhua (Wise Man - Level 7) applies to add a friend. The verification message is: No. 2 is the eldest sister and I! Do you want to accept it?
Seeing this friend invitation, Liu Ye's lips curled up unconsciously, and he reluctantly clicked to add. Soon he received a friend message from the bully second lady, "No. 2, gather quickly! Xiaolin (4590, 12598)!"
Faced with the bully second lady, Liu Ye would certainly not forget to flatter him, and replied with a chuckle: "Wow, the second lady's name is so poetic! I wonder what's wrong with calling her younger?"
"Oh, stop flattering! Someone is looking for a place. If you don't come, I will kill you, big sister!"
Liu Ye was stunned.He hurriedly replied: "Don't worry, Miss, I'll be there soon!"
After closing the dialog box, Liu Ye looked a little weird. He, the second young lady, was really worried. How long had this started? Getting into trouble so quickly? !
But then again, as a legal prostitute, I have the obligation to protect the safety of the second lady and obey the orders of the second lady. If the second lady is bullied in the game, the responsibility will definitely be on me.
Thinking of the murderous look in the eyes of the eldest lady Ye Yuxuan, Liu Ye couldn't help but tremble, and spread his legs to kill at the designated coordinates, "My second lady! You must hold on. How can I survive in the Ye family if you die?"
Full of enthusiasm, Liu Ye temporarily gave up the mission of killing the big black bear and ran towards the scene of the incident in a hurry!
Fortunately, he was also in the woods, and the incident location was not far away. Liu Ye arrived quickly three minutes later.
I saw two petite girls fighting fiercely over there. Among them, the wise player named Die Lianhua was her eldest sister Daye Yudie, and her opponent was an equally arrogant little Loli mage with the ID name Magic Kitten!
The two of them were fighting and cursing each other, each looking more arrogant than the other. Liu Ye became more and more dumbfounded as he watched. It was obvious that the bully second lady had met her match.
